title: [GMCP 203.034.02] Production path: Audit, privacy, provenance, and compliance evidence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-034-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A single tamper-evident event model records MCP lifecycle, discovery, policy, consent, install, auth, invocation, data egress, callback, task and administrative outcomes with correlation and provenance but no secret or raw sensitive payload. Retention, deletion, export and subject boundaries are configurable; completeness canaries catch bypasses; and an evidence bundle reproduces every completion claim from immutable test and build artifacts. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
